_what: WHAT_CHANGES_THE_ANSWER (design doc §4.2 row 21): the heading, its giant watermark numeral, the two ledger column headers, and the observation rows themselves. Heading numeral and orn must both equal the row count, but the build does not derive either automatically — see notes.
heading_html: 4 things you can see that can narrow the list fast

columns.label: What it rules out for you

rows.rules_out: Fan on ON instead of AUTO can explain air that is warm between cooling cycles. One photo settles mode, set point, room temperature and fan.

rows.look: Ice on the larger copper line
rows.rules_out: Changes what you should do in the next 5 minutes, and moves airflow and refrigerant to the front.
A still fan with a hum points somewhere very different from a fan spinning normally.

rows.look: Every room, or one end of the house
rows.rules_out: Whole-house and one-room problems have almost no causes in common.
